battleTraits.name: BLOOD-DRENCHED
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skulls for the Skull Throne’ ability
battleTraits.effect:
After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a BLOOD TITHE ability this turn, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
Wild-eyed Brutality: Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
Blood Haze: If the target is BLOODBOUND, its Blood-hungry weapons have Crit (Mortal).
Weapons of Murder: If the target is a non-MONSTER DAEMON unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons, including Blood-hungry Companion weapons.
Bloodlords Supreme: If the target is a MONSTER, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons.

battleTraits.name: BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock BLOOD TITHE abilities. You can only use BLOOD TITHE abilities that are unlocked. Once a BLOOD TITHE ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

battleTraits.name: SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick a BLOOD TITHE ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability (shown in the top-right corner of the ability). That BLOOD TITHE ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: MURDERLUST
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
battleTraits.effect:
You do not need to unlock this ability to use it. It is already unlocked.
Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that CHARGE ability after that ability is resolved.

battleTraits.name: DIVINE SCORN
battleTraits.timing: Once per Turn, Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy WIZARDS or PRIESTS within 6" of any friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units to be the target(s).
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

battleTraits.name: PUNISH THE PACIFIST
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy MANIFESTATION that is not in combat is a target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

battleTraits.name: MURDER THE MYSTIC
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy MANIFESTATIONS to be the target(s).
battleTraits.effect:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Divine Scorn’.
Make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is banished and removed from play.

battleTraits.name: GLORIOUS COMBAT OR NAUGHT
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Divine Scorn’ or ‘Punish the Pacifist’.
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.

battleTraits.name: REVEL IN BATTLE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Punish the Pacifist’.
Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit have no effect.

battleTraits.name: SLAUGHTER TRIUMPHANT
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Murder the Mystic’ or ‘Glorious Combat or Naught’.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units that charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: CLEAVE WIDE THE GRIN OF KHORNE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
You can only unlock this ability if you have already unlocked ‘Revel in Battle’ or ‘Glorious Combat or Naught’.
Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.

battleTraits.name: MURDER-WON TROPHIES
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Give the target 1 artefact of power from the ’Gorechosen Champions’ Army of Renown rules.
Designer’s Note: This artefact of power is given to the HERO during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

battleTraits.name: BRUTAL LASHMASTER
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly Bloodstoker uses the ’Whipped to Fury’ ability, another friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit.

battleTraits.name: LEGENDARY SLAYERS
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have Crit (Mortal).

battleTraits.name: THE RED GOD’S EYE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have WARD (6+).

battleTraits.name: HATE-FUELLED KILLERS
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The first time each friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) that unit.

battleTraits.name: BORN OF BUTCHERY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BALEFUL LORDS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: BELLOW OF HATRED
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: MAGE-EATERS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: A friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit targeted by that Spell ability.
Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, that spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

battleTraits.name: FIRST IN HIS SIGHT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
battleTraits.effect: Heal (D3) each friendly BALEFUL LORDS HERO that is in combat.

battleTraits.name: DRAWN BY BLOOD
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.
If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:
That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.

battleTraits.name: THE PRICE OF MERCY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that did not charge or use a FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: SUNDER THE SORCEROUS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy MANIFESTATION within 3" of a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit to be a target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
• That target is banished and removed from play.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.

abilities.name: BUTCHERS OF NATIONS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that FIGHT ability.
Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: TIRELESS CONQUERORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLOODBOUND units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: DRAWN TO CARNAGE
abilities.effect: Add X to charge rolls for friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units, where X is the number of friendly BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY or MONSTER units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

abilities.name: EAGER KILLERS
abilities.effect: Each friendly BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit that has used a FIGHT ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: BLOODY COMPETITORS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit and a friendly non-HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.

abilities.name: TIDE OF SAVAGERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND HERO and up to 2 other friendly BLOODBOUND units that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: UNCONTROLLABLE RAGE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the ’Blood-drenched’ ability apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of ’Wild-eyed Brutality’ on the target.

entries.name: BLOOD BOIL
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: FINAL ACT OF VIOLENCE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: GOREFLESH
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: RUNES OF LOATHING
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS (including FIGHT abilities). If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: GIFT OF APOPLEXY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE, CHARGE or FIGHT ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

entries.name: STOKE THE FLAMES
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Blades of Khorne unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 rage dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 rage dice instead.

entries.name: GIFT OF APOPLEXY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE or FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

entries.name: FETTERS OF BLOOD
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use RETREAT or RUN abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

entries.name: SUMMON HEXGORGER SKULLS
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Hexgorger Skulls invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Hexgorger Skulls invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Hexgorger Skulls invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.

entries.name: SUMMON WRATH-AXE
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON BLEEDING ICON
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bleeding Icon on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bleeding Icon wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

entries.name: Bleeding Icon

abilityDetails.name: Sigil of Doom
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 8" of this Manifestation to be the target. Then, pick a passive BLOOD TITHE ability that you have not unlocked this battle.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the blood tithe points cost of the chosen ability, until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.

entries.flavour: A common sight in the crimson skies above Khorne’s domain in the Realm of Chaos, a Bleeding Icon can be summoned to the Mortal Realms to skewer from on high those who have displeased the Lord of Battle.

entries.name: Blood Warriors

abilityDetails.name: No Respite
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, it has WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: Smashing their way through the maelstrom of battle, Blood Warriors roar incoherent curses as they hack and bludgeon their foes to ruin. Such is their dedication to Khorne that they continue to fight even after suffering wounds that would fell most warriors instantly.

entries.name: Bloodcrushers

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Onslaught
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If the unmodified charge roll for this unit is 8+:
• For the rest of the phase, this unit can pass through models in enemy units.
• Enemy CAVALRY units passed through by this unit in this phase cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The ground shakes beneath the onrushing fury of the Bloodcrushers before they crash into the enemy with the force of a falling mountain. Those not trampled beneath the Juggernauts’ hooves are slain by the swinging hellblades of the beasts’ riders.

entries.name: Bloodletters

abilityDetails.name: Ceaseless Violence
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: Beneath unholy icons and blood-soaked banners, letting loose roaring battle cries and terrifying blasts from brazen horns, the Bloodletters of Khorne surge forwards in a tide of corded muscle and hellforged swords to maim and slaughter their foes.

entries.name: Bloodmaster, Herald of Khorne

abilityDetails.name: The Blood Must Flow
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Bloodletters unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit and that friendly Bloodletters unit.

entries.flavour: Each swing of the Bloodmaster’s blade opens throats and splits torsos, while truly worthy victims find their heads severed from their bodies. Around the Herald, the Bloodletters of Khorne fight all the harder, driven to a frenzy by his murderous aura.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaughter Seeker

entries.name: Bloodreavers

abilityDetails.name: Blood For The Blood God!
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

entries.flavour: Descending on their foes in a howling tide, the barbarous hordes of the Bloodreavers sweep away the enemy in a brutal frenzy. Each is a frothing killer, their body thick with slabs of muscle and their heavy weapons able to decapitate and dismember with every swing.

entries.name: Bloodsecrator

abilityDetails.name: Icon of the Blood God
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If a friendly BLOODBOUND unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilityDetails.name: Rage of Khorne
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons used by friendly BLOODBOUND units for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Howling in rage, the Bloodsecrator hacks and smashes their way through the foe with their Icon of Khorne held high. This grim standard channels the wrathful energies of the Blood God’s domain to the battlefield, filling their followers with an infernal battle-lust that is terrifying to behold.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger.

entries.name: Bloodstoker

abilityDetails.name: Whipped To Fury
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

entries.flavour: Every whip-crack of the Bloodstoker’s expertly plied lash builds the battle-frenzy of those around him, their screams of hatred and fury echoing across the battlefield as they pelt towards the foe with wrathful abandon.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger.

entries.name: Bloodthirster of Insensate Rage

abilityDetails.name: Outrageous Carnage
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time an attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 8" of it after the FIGHT ability has been resolved (and continue the attack sequence).

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Great Axe of Khorne is 3.

abilityDetails.name: Shattering Charge
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is INFANTRY, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on it.

melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Blood-hungry · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: A Bloodthirster of Insensate Rage is an avatar of supreme carnage upon the battlefield, charging forwards with horrific momentum to shatter entire formations with the force of its impact, before carving a ruinous path through the survivors.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Baleful Lord.

entries.name: Bloodthirster of Unfettered Fury

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Axe of Khorne is 4 .

abilityDetails.name: Beckon The Hunt
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target, roll l additional dice, to a maximum of 3, and discard 1 dice of your choice.

abilityDetails.name: Ensnaring Lash
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is in combat with this unit when the target is picked to use a FIGHT ability:
• It must pick this unit to be the target of the pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3).
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability against this unit.

melee: Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend), Blood-hungry · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: As the Bloodthirster of Unfettered Fury stalks forwards, its whip lashing out to strip flesh from bone, the very earth bleeds beneath its smouldering hooves, causing gouts of molten rock to incinerate all who dare to oppose the unholy terror before them.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Baleful Lord.

entries.name: Claws of Karanak

abilityDetails.name: The Scent of Blood
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilityDetails.name: Pack Hunters
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Flesh Hounds unit or a friendly Karanak, this unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

entries.flavour: The Claws of Karanak venerate the Flesh Hounds of Khorne, taking on an aspect of the daemons’ bloodthirsty nature as they hunt the enemies of the Blood God and hack them to shreds in horrific displays of brutality.

entries.name: Deathbringer

abilityDetails.name: Trophies of Glorious Deaths
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 8" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On an 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.

abilityDetails.name: Killer of Kings
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit and MANIFESTATION in combat with this unit to be a target.
Effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model from that unit is slain or, if the target is a MANIFESTATION, it is automatically destroyed.

entries.flavour: Lieutenants and champions amongst the Bloodbound hordes, Deathbringers are ascendant warriors who desire to claim the mantle of lordship. To earn their throne they must offer the mightiest trophies to Khorne – the skulls of kings and warlords, pursued with a formidable intensity.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger.
entries.description:
The following units no longer have current warscrolls: Aspiring Deathbringer; Exalted Deathbringer. You can use the models in these units to represent the following units as appropriate, provided they are on the listed base sizes:
Aspiring Deathbringer → Deathbringer (40mm)
Exalted Deathbringer → Deathbringer (40mm)

entries.name: Flesh Hounds

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Hunters of Mystics
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If the casting roll for an enemy WIZARD within 12" of this unit contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast.
If the chanting roll for an enemy PRIEST within 12" of this unit is an unmodified 2, the prayer fails and its effect is not resolved. In addition, your opponent cannot give that PRIEST any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

entries.flavour: Swift, strong, and tenacious beyond mortal reason, Flesh Hounds run their prey to the ground without mercy. Those who seek to trick or destroy these daemonic beasts with sorcery find their powers flickering to nothing, extinguished by the wrath of Khorne.

entries.name: Garrek’s Reavers

abilityDetails.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Grisly Trophies
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is in a Blades of Khorne army and any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit’s attacks, you gain 1 blood tithe point.

entries.flavour: Even amongst the pitiless hordes of the Goretide, the Bloodreavers led by Garrek Gorebeard are known for their cruelty and deranged ferocity. It is said that Garrek personally guts and skins any of his warriors who fail to take a worthy trophy in battle.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Reaver Blades and Axes. The models in this unit are:
• Garrek Gorebeard (champion)
• Blooded Saek
• Karsus the Chained
• Targor
• Arnulf

entries.name: Gorechosen of Dromm

abilityDetails.name: Dromm, Wounder of Worlds
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Dromm, Wounder of Worlds, is on the battlefield, it has PRIEST (1) and can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

entries.flavour: Dromm, Wounder of Worlds, Slaughterpriest of Great Khorne, seeks to commit the ultimate act of violence in the name of his murderous god. With his cursed axe he would carve open the realms themselves, causing the lands to shudder and writhe in agony. Together known as the Gorechosen of Dromm, the Skullgrinder Herax and the muscle- bound Gorehulk accompany the self-proclaimed Wounder of Worlds on his deranged quest to mutilate the realms, slaughtering anything that gets in their way.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Weapons of Wrath. The models in this unit are:
• Dromm, Wounder of Worlds (champion)
• Skullgrinder Herax
• The Gorehulk

entries.name: Herald of Khorne on Blood Throne

abilityDetails.name: Offering of Blood
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit’s power level, to a maximum of 2.

abilityDetails.name: Blood Marked
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has WARD (4+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

entries.flavour: The Blood Throne roars into battle with its monstrous maw gaping wide, hungry for mortal flesh. Atop its dais, the Rendmaster bellows commands to his footsoldiers as it and its charioteers cut down any foes foolish enough to approach.

entries.name: Hexgorger Skulls

abilityDetails.name: Multiple Parts
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this MANIFESTATION moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this MANIFESTATION is armed with a Stream of Molten Blood.

abilityDetails.name: Hexgorgers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For each part of this MANIFESTATION that is within 8" of a WIZARD (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that WIZARD.

entries.flavour: Hexgorger Skulls are the physical manifestation of Khorne’s hatred of the arcane arts. They drift across the battlefield, seeking to feed upon eldritch energy and those conjurers who attempt to use it.

entries.name: Kamandora’s Blades

abilityDetails.name: Khornate Hound
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s Kannat is a token. Each time you declare a FIGHT ability for this unit while its Kannat is on the battlefield, as a reaction, you can remove its Kannat from the battlefield and then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s Bloodied Weapons for the rest of the phase.

abilityDetails.name: Gather The Skulls!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain and you earn 1 blood tithe point.

entries.flavour: Kamandora’s Blades dwell in the wastes left by Khorne’s armies. Guided by their matriarch, the feral clanmates Ghalista, Antro Krast and the hound Kannat weaken and bleed their foes before Throkk hacks their heads free. It is the clan’s goal to add these to the charnel pyramid that marks where the legendary Korghos Khul attained daemonhood. On their journey, they must pass through Embergard, where Kamandora senses worthy skulls to claim...
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Bloodied Weapons. The models in this unit are:
• Kamandora (champion)
• Throkk
• Ghalista
• Antro Krast

entries.name: Karanak

abilityDetails.name: First of the Pack
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Flesh Hounds unit, add 2 to charge rolls for this unit. In addition, while any friendly Flesh Hounds units are wholly within 12" of this unit, they can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.

abilityDetails.name: Prey of the Blood God
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick an enemy HERO to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a HERO in reserve.

abilityDetails.name: Stalk The Prey
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s quarry is on the battlefield, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Flesh Hounds unit to be the targets.
Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from this unit’s quarry and more than 9" from all other enemy units. If picked to be a target, the unit of Flesh Hounds must also be set up wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.flavour: Ever watchful, ever hungry, Karanak is the physical manifestation of the Blood God’s wrathful vengeance. Once he has the scent of his quarry, this tireless hunter will not cease in his hunt until he tastes their torn flesh between his fangs.

entries.name: Khorgorath

abilityDetails.name: Horrific Predators
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Feast Upon Their Bones
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy non-MONSTER units while they are in combat with this unit.

entries.flavour: All know to fear the Khorgoraths of Khorne. Rampaging super-predators with an endless hunger for skulls, they are almost impossible to kill and smash through the enemy with no thought for anything but indiscriminate slaughter.

entries.name: Khul Ascended

abilityDetails.name: Ascended Warlord
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Axe of Khorne for each other friendly BLADES OF KH0RNE unit that is within this unit’s combat range and is in combat.

abilityDetails.name: Reality Splitting Axe
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, 1 model in that unit is slain.

abilityDetails.name: Loathe The Arcane
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use this ability if it is not in combat. This unit can move 3" but must end that move closer to the unit that used the SPELL ability. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

entries.flavour: Following the Vermindoom, Korghos Khul passed into the mists of blood-soaked myth. Not even his own followers truly knew what had become of their warlord, for those who fought alongside him in that last battle against the Hammers of Sigmar were consumed by apocalyptic fires. And yet legend tells that Khul endures. As the Hour of Ruin descended he was remade as a Daemon Prince of Khorne – a slaughterous demigod empowered by the howls of the faithful. He is cruel conquest and massacre made flesh, and wherever he roams, empires burn.
entries.notes: Legends Warscroll

entries.name: Korghos Khul

abilityDetails.name: Master of The Goretide
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Spend 3 blood tithe points and pick a friendly BLOODBOUND unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, 1 model in that unit is slain.

abilityDetails.name: Retinue of Blood
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each friendly BLOODBOUND HERO within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
Effect: The target’s melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Warlord of the legendary Goretide, Korghos Khul is rightly feared across the Mortal Realms. His campaigns of conquest have earned him many boons from Khorne – principal amongst them an axe capable of ripping open the skin of reality, and the enormous Flesh Hound known as Grizzlemaw that fights by his side. Khul, though, is more than a mere butcher. He has turned his horde of cannibals and killers into a true army – still driven by a need to slaughter, but also able to heed both his commands and those of his favoured generals.
entries.notes: Legends Warscroll

entries.name: Lord of Khorne on Juggernaut

abilityDetails.name: Lord of the Brass Stampede
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Already a terrifying opponent in their own right, a Khornate lord astride a Juggernaut is an unstoppable force of destruction. Foes are crushed or hacked apart in seconds, while the sheer momentum of their ruinous steed draws their warriors howling in their wake.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2026.

entries.name: Magore’s Fiends

abilityDetails.name: No Respite
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll 2 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.flavour: Magore Redhand leads his band of killers on an endless hunt for worthy skulls. In return for his prodigious offerings, Khorne has blessed the Blood Warrior with profane gifts, including a daemonic maw in his gut that can bite through even sigmarite.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
The models in this unit are:
• Magore Redhand (champion, armed with a Goreaxe)
• Zharkus the Bloodsighted (armed with a Goreaxe)
• Ghartok Flayskull (armed with a Goreaxe)
• Riptooth (armed with Blood-dark Claws)

entries.name: Mighty Lord of Khorne

abilityDetails.name: Lord of the Bloodbound
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly BLOODBOUND INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: ’Bring Me Their Skull!’
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another friendly BLOODBOUND INFANTRY HERO wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Leaders of the Bloodbound warhordes, Mighty Lords of Khorne are supreme killers even amongst a society dedicated to slaughter. As they carve a gory path across the battlefield they send their warriors surging forth to claim more skulls in Khorne’s name.

entries.name: Mighty Skullcrushers

abilityDetails.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: The ground shakes beneath pounding Juggernaut hooves as the Mighty Skullcrushers ride into battle. Foes are smashed aside by the impact of their charge, and any survivors are soon reduced to piles of gore by the riders’ axes.

entries.name: Realmgore Ritualist

abilityDetails.name: Desecrating Blood Runes
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLOODBOUND units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

entries.flavour: Realmgore Ritualists curse both the enemies of Khorne and the land itself. Blasphemous hexes are laid upon the foe to sap their strength, while bleeding runes are carved into the earth, imbuing it with an aura of rage that drives their allies to commit relentless acts of murder.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Blood Warriors

abilityDetails.name: Only the Worthy
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of models in this unit that are slain.
$000003123

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Blades of Khorne
entries.flavour: Their battle fury stoked into an all-consuming inferno by Aqshy’s fiery spirit, Blood Warriors lose themselves in the carnage of the battlefield. Wild‐eyed and frenzied, they mutilate and slaughter any who stand in their way.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Bloodletters

abilityDetails.name: Drawn to Slaughter
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You or your opponent declared the ‘%000024072Eruption of Fury%’ ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit. If your opponent declared that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability and the unit using the ability is in combat with this unit, return 3 slain models to this unit instead.

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Blades of Khorne
entries.flavour: It was through Aqshy’s Clavis Rift that Khorne’s daemonic legions first spilled into the Mortal Realms, and his hate-filled Bloodletters have been drowning the lands in gore ever since, slaking their irrepressible thirst for violence with the blood of the enemy.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Bloodcrushers

abilityDetails.name: Brass Stampede
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through models in the target unit and must end that move in combat.

entries.source: Scourge of Ghyran - Blades of Khorne
entries.flavour: Some of Khorne’s daemons develop an obsession with bone-shattering cavalry combat. Riding into battle atop smoke-belching Juggernauts, they call themselves Bloodcrushers, and it is a name well earned. Rather than winding through the trees of the Everspring Swathe, they simply bulldoze a path forward, driving the panicked survivors of their rampage onto the axes of their Khornate kin.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Mighty Lord of Khorne

abilityDetails.name: Howl of Blood-Curdling Savagery
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly BLOODBOUND unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
Effect: The target can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the target has charged.

abilityDetails.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick an enemy HERO that was allocated any damage points by this unit’s Axe of Khorne this turn to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.

entries.source: Scourge of Ghyran - Blades of Khorne
entries.flavour: The greatest of the Blood God’s mortal warlords are the Mighty Lords of Khorne. These hulking figures feast on violence and bloodshed, charging into battle at the head of their berserk warriors. Many of these arch-slaughterers have sworn an oath to drown Ghyran in blood. Each swipe of their daemonic axes tears at the realm’s integrity, allowing Khorne’s fury to spill through the breaches.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scyla Anfingrimm

abilityDetails.name: Brass Collar of Khorne
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilityDetails.name: Bestial Leap
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this phase, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6" as if it had FLY but must end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: Ferocity made flesh and blood, Scyla Anfingrimm is a terrifying foe who knows nothing of fear or mercy. His monstrous strength is such that he can tear a Dracoth in two, and sorcery can gain no purchase upon his form, for his collar radiates Khorne’s hatred.

entries.name: Skarbrand

abilityDetails.name: Skarbrand’s Rage
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a FIGHT ability last turn, the effects of the ’Blood-drenched’ ability apply to this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Inescapable Wrath
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilityDetails.name: Roar of Total Rage
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: A daemonic engine of destruction like no other, Skarbrand carves a red road of ruin across the battlefield. His bellowing roars cause the blood to boil in his enemies’ veins, and his twin axes create a rain of gore with every almighty swing.

entries.name: Skarr Bloodwrath

abilityDetails.name: The Slaughterborn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
Effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Murderous Paragon
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Wrathmongers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.flavour: In battle, Skarr Bloodwrath is a terrifying maelstrom of carnage. The Bloodstorm Blades whip around him like extensions of his furious will, and even should he fall, he rises again from the spilt blood of his victims, his axes held ready for vengeance.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2026.

entries.name: Skull Cannon

abilities: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls

abilityDetails.name: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any enemy models are slain by a FIGHT ability used by this unit, after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, this unit can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase.

abilityDetails.name: Gruesome Bombardment
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by a SHOOT ability used by this unit, subtract 3 from that enemy unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The hideous war machines known as Skull Cannons vomit forth barrages of skulls amidst blasts of sulphurous smoke and flame, their macabre ordnance screaming through the skies before exploding with murderous fury amongst the enemy ranks.

entries.name: Skullgrinder

abilityDetails.name: Tempered By Fury
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another friendly BLOODBOUND HERO within 8" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilityDetails.name: Bone-crushing Strikes
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Control characteristic, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Trailing sulphurous flame, the chained anvil of the Skullgrinder roars through the air like a dark mockery of Sigmar’s twin-tailed comet. The Khornate smith swings his mighty weapon in wide arcs, shattering armour, pulping flesh and smashing bone.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger.

entries.name: Skullmaster, Herald of Khorne

abilityDetails.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Herald of Trampling Death
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly Bloodcrushers unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by this unit and the target have Charge (+1 Damage).

entries.flavour: The war cry of the Skullmaster rings out over the thunderous hoofbeats of its ironclad steed moments before it slams into the foe with titanic force. Armour buckles, flesh tears, bones shatter and blood falls like rain as the Herald exults in the carnage.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2026.

entries.name: Skullreapers

abilityDetails.name: Trial of Skulls
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 8 to this unit’s control score while it is in combat.

entries.flavour: It is the sworn task of the Skullreapers to claim worthy skulls for Khorne, and it is a duty they go about with savage determination. Wielding daemon-touched weapons and blessed with death-dealing mutations, these warriors decimate the enemy ranks.

entries.name: Skulltaker

abilityDetails.name: Heroes’ Bane
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy HERO.

abilityDetails.name: The Eternal Duel
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If an enemy HERO had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that HERO was destroyed this turn, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points this unit has.

abilityDetails.name: Drawn By Blood
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the target.
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.

entries.flavour: Skulltaker is Khorne’s immortal champion and the greatest of all Bloodletters. Ever seeking worthy skulls for his master, he scans the battlefield for the enemy’s mightiest warrior, bellowing his challenge before moving in to end yet another storied life.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaughter Seeker.

entries.name: Slaughterpriest

abilityDetails.name: Blood Sacrifice
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit gains 1 ritual point.

abilityDetails.name: Scorn of Sorcery
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

entries.flavour: Towering, brutal demagogues, Slaughterpriests are living beacons of the Lord of Battle’s power. These foul priests direct their comrades according to visions sent by Khorne himself, boil their enemies’ blood in their veins and drive the foe mad with battle-lust.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger

entries.name: Valkia The Bloody

abilityDetails.name: Borne On Wings Of Blood
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
Effect: Set up this unit in reserve soaring above the battlefield. It has now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: The Red Angel of Slaughter
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is soaring above the battlefield.
Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: The Gaze of Khorne
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If a friendly BLOODBOUND unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. However, friendly BLOODBOUND units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are within 12" of this unit.

entries.flavour: To incur Valkia’s wrath is to invite death. She streaks down from the skies like a bolt of crimson lightning, driving her spear with such force that she impales multiple foes in a spectacularly gruesome fashion. With her comes the Blood God’s judgement, for wherever Valkia goes, the eye of Khorne follows.

entries.name: Wrath of Khorne Bloodthirster

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Wrathful Dominance
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy HERO.

abilityDetails.name: Vengeance of Khorne
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 8 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilityDetails.name: Commander Of Tyrants
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly non-UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit to be the target.
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

melee: Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail
Anti-HERO (+1 Rend), Blood-hungry · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Wrath of Khorne Bloodthirsters are the Lord of Battle’s agents of vengeance, sent to claim the skulls of those who have offended him. With hellforged weapons and breath of purest hellfire, they annihilate their quarry in shocking displays of infernal power.

entries.name: Wrath-Axe

abilityDetails.name: Hatred’s Edge
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this MANIFESTATION charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

entries.flavour: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne’s otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing red-hot from the Blood God’s rage. At signs of weakness or wizardry, such a blazing axe appears in the air, splitting reality with its downwards stroke.

entries.name: Wrathmongers

abilityDetails.name: Crimson Haze
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly BLOODBOUND units, excluding Wrathmongers units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Bloodfury
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target’s own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit).
Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.

entries.flavour: With the chained hammers of their flails whipping around them, the Wrathmongers hurl themselves at the enemy. A bloody red mist hangs around these berserkers as they go about their butchery, driving combatants into a maddened frenzy.
